methodologyNote: Latency is end-to-end per attempt (recall + fixture plan + authorization transaction), measured from a shared development host against a managed CockroachDB Cloud cluster with a 40-connection pool serving 1000 concurrent attempts. It is dominated by client connection-pool queuing under that contention, not transaction execution time alone, and should not be read as a production benchmark. The correctness numbers above (approvedActions, duplicateApprovedActions, dbGroundTruth) are the release-gate-relevant ones and do not depend on absolute host or network latency.
